definition.name: Current-source signed ordinary C once interleaving

steps.name: Start the finite C once qualification clock
Prepare pinned bindings and compiler containment
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Build current products and qualify signed once and root-drain activations
steps.run:
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_once_runtime
python3 -B tools/qualify_c_once_runtime.py --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-once-runtime"

steps.name: Retain bounded once proof including failures

with.name: c-once-runtime-${{ github.run_id }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/qualified.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/owner-inputs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/project/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/build/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/native-build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/native-build/native/native-tuple.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/qualified.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/signed/release-set.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/signed/c-thread-runtime/package/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/signed/c-thread-runtime/evidence/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/signed/c-thread-runtime/deployment.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/controls/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/commands/**
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/invocation-*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/retirement-*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/*.stdout
${{ runner.temp }}/c-once-runtime/node/*.stderr

reviewReason: Build exact current native products and one signed once component; retain success and failure evidence without holding cancelled runs. Keep the same host and component build while adding two bounded root-drain invocations.
